metadata.methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded during a delayed free recall task with word encoding, distractor arithmetic, and free recall phases. An L2 logistic regression classifier trained on FR1 session data predicted subsequent recall from spectral power features (Morlet wavelet transform, 8 frequencies 3-180 Hz) computed from bipolar recordings 0-1366 ms post-word presentation, after removing line noise with a Butterworth band-stop filter. Classifier performance was validated via leave-one-session-out cross-validation with permutation testing. During closed-loop sessions, stimulation was delivered to a single electrode pair based on real-time classifier output relative to a training-derived median threshold, with stimulation parameters (anode/cathode, amplitude, frequency, pulse width, pulse count) recorded in behavioral event files.
